content: {"reasoning":"CO-50 remains appealable, while retro authorization and peer-to-peer are unavailable and CO-16 document submission does not apply. Despite two prior appeals, similar Medicare claims were most often paid after medical-necessity appeals (3/7), and billing the patient or writing off would prematurely abandon payer recovery. A further appeal should directly address the invalid CPT-diagnosis pairing with the strongest supported clinical rationale.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
